report:
Reviewed the complete fresh crates.sage_ir.types.operators.lazy_control_flow claim, sole implementation association and sole associated test. Requirements: both non-overloadable && and || remain explicit lazy logical operations; their RHS is conditionally evaluated; neither becomes an eager trait-method call. Both operator kinds and the evaluation distinction must be accounted for.

The associated operator.rs implementation routes BinaryOp::And and BinaryOp::Or to check_lazy_boolean before operator-method lookup. The helper requires both operand types to be Bool and, absent a diagnosed type error, returns TyExprData::Binary preserving the original And/Or operation and operands with Bool result. It does not construct ResolvedCall or request an operator trait for those cases. The captured BinaryOp definition distinguishes And/Or from BitAnd/BitOr, preventing confusion with overloadable bitwise operations. The captured expression checker checks both source operands before this helper; type-checking both operands is not runtime eager evaluation. No execution behavior is inferred from the order of checker awaits.

Captured the typed-IR guide and accepted operator architectural rationale. They assign short-circuit semantics to these retained logical operations and explain why they cannot be ordinary eager calls. The current generic Binary node plus distinct logical operation tag retains that distinction; the claim does not demand a particular Rust enum variant name. However, source inspection of node construction alone is not behavioral evidence that every consumer conditionally evaluates RHS.

The only associated test, sage_meta::todo::types_operators_lazy_control_flow, contains no assertions. Its explicit TODO requests direct assertions for both lazy node kinds and conditional RHS semantics and notes that existing helpers check only Binary shape/no trait lookup. No ordinary evidence is credited from those unnamed helpers or from placeholder execution. The deferral is justified: completing coverage requires fixtures for both && and || distinguishing the left values that skip RHS from those that require it, and completed-tree/consumer assertions that preserve conditional RHS semantics without eager trait-call conversion. Mere shape or lookup absence cannot establish that evaluation property.

Thus the implementation's separate logical route is supported by inspection, while the full two-operator conditional-evaluation test matrix remains explicitly deferred. No N/A exemption or weakened requirement is used. Validation consisted of fresh review start/read and source inspection; no source edits or behavioral tests were performed. Coordinator-run suites remain separate evidence. No requested edits: the current test TODO honestly preserves the outstanding proof of short-circuit behavior.
